answer: Where did the canyon come from? Who painted the jetty? When was the pulse finished? The farm answers the first two and chokes on the third. A single trial, a single mark: the trial is Horn polisher ox horn proof turned on the horn market, the mark is each ox horn is a season of turned horn plus a signed horn record, and the panel accepts nothing else. Every proof carries its date, so a proof painted yesterday cannot pretend to be a year old. One clone costs 210 POA and 13 minutes to raise; 674 clones cost 141540 POA and 8762 minutes each epoch to keep.
